node.title: Comparing different timestamp formats
node.author: htmanning
node.doctext:
Monks,

I'm trying to tell if a transaction occurred more than 1 day ago. I have a $last_timeout value in the database saved as a timestamp by MySQL in this format: Tue Oct 23, 2018 - 19:57:12 Perl's DateTime's "now" feature is in this format: 2018-10-24T10:37:03

What is the best way to go about this? All I need to do is subtract one from the other to see if the value is >= 1.
